sections.title: Computer Vision Applications for Chicago Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade CV solutions for Chicago's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Food Manufacturing Quality Inspection
paragraphs: For Conagra (Chicago HQ), Kraft Heinz (Chicago heritage), Wrigley/Mars (Chicago), and Chicago's world-class food manufacturing cluster:

Packaged food quality inspection: CV for Conagra's and Kraft Heinz's high-volume food packaging lines — detecting underfilled packages, misapplied labels, seal failures, and product contamination at production line speeds that exceed 1,000 units per minute.

Confectionery and candy inspection: CV for Wrigley's and Mars's candy and gum manufacturing — color consistency, shape uniformity, and wrapping quality inspection for products where aesthetic quality is a primary consumer expectation.

Fresh and prepared food inspection: CV for Chicago's large frozen and refrigerated food manufacturing sector — portioning consistency, color quality, and foreign material detection for prepared food products.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | FDA FSMA, HACCP context

blocks.heading: Rail and Transportation Infrastructure
paragraphs: For the Class I railroads converging on Chicago (Union Pacific, BNSF, CSX, Norfolk Southern, CN, CP) and Chicago's large intermodal logistics community:

Track inspection CV: Machine vision for automated track defect detection from rail inspection vehicles — detecting rail head defects, broken rails, gauge defects, and tie deterioration in Chicago's heavily-used rail network.

Rail yard operations: CV for intermodal terminal operations — automated container identification, chassis equipment inspection, and truck ingress/egress management at Chicago's large intermodal facilities.
Locomotive and rail car inspection: CV for pre-departure mechanical inspection — detecting visible defects on rolling stock during terminal dwell before trains depart Chicago's classification yards.
Cost: $60,000–$165,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | FRA safety requirements

blocks.heading: Medical Imaging AI
paragraphs: For Advocate Aurora Health, Northwestern Medicine, and Chicago's large healthcare system:

Radiology workflow AI: Study prioritization and acute finding detection for Chicago's large radiology departments — Northwestern's Lurie Children's Hospital, Advocate Aurora's multi-campus radiology network, and Chicago's academic medical centers.

Pathology digital slides: Whole-slide image analysis for tumor grading and cell counting for Northwestern's Robert H. Lurie Comprehensive Cancer Center and Rush University Medical Center's pathology programs.
Cardiac imaging AI: Echocardiogram analysis for Chicago's large cardiovascular programs at NorthShore University Health System and Northwestern's Bluhm Cardiovascular Institute.
Cost: $65,000–$175,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | HIPAA + BIPA-aware

blocks.heading: Retail and CPG Shelf Analytics
paragraphs: For the CPG brands managing their retail presence across Chicago's diverse neighborhoods:

Shelf compliance monitoring: CV for CPG brands' shelf presence monitoring across Chicago's large retail footprint — detecting out-of-stocks, planogram deviations, and competitive displacement in Chicago stores.

Retail loss prevention: Anonymous shopper behavior analytics for Chicago's retail operators — theft detection and loss prevention analytics without facial recognition (avoiding BIPA compliance issues).
Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | BIPA-compliant (no facial recognition)

sections.title: Chicago CV Technical Context
sections.description: Key considerations for CV development in Chicago.

blocks.heading: BIPA: No facial recognition by default
paragraphs: Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act applies to any biometric data collection in Chicago commercial applications — ClickMasters designs all Chicago retail, healthcare, and commercial CV without facial recognition by default, using body pose, clothing attributes, and behavioral signals that provide analytics value without biometric data.

blocks.heading: Food manufacturing throughput requirements
paragraphs: Chicago's high-volume food manufacturing lines operate at throughputs that require CV inference at sub-50ms per frame — ClickMasters designs Chicago food manufacturing CV for the inference speed and reliability that production-line integration requires.
